test_title: PYST 53: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven boxes U, V, W, X, E, F and G are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

Only V is kept above E. Only W is kept between E and U. Only F is kept below X. How many boxes are kept between G and F?
solution:
Seven boxes U, V, W, X, E, F and G are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

 
• Only V is kept above E.
 
• Only W is kept between E and U.
 
• Only F is kept below X.

The Final Arrangement is,

 
 

 
 
V

 
 
 

 
 
E

 
 
 

 
 
W

 
 
 

 
 
U

 
 
 

 

 
G

 
 
 

 
 
X

 
 
 

 
 
F
